intent: Generate a weekly security posture report covering vulnerability scan results, patch compliance, and incident summary for the CISO
minimum_outcome: Report covers all three required sections: vulnerability scan results, patch compliance metrics, incident summary with data no older than 7 days
target_outcome: Report includes trend analysis comparing current week to 4-week rolling average, risk prioritization matrix ranking vulnerabilities by exploitability and asset criticality, and executive summary with strategic recommendations

available_tools.description: Tenable Nessus vulnerability scanner API for retrieving scan results

metadata.scenario: Paper Section 11 - CISO Weekly Security Report
metadata.claim: RQ1 - Verifiable success criteria with anchor extraction
metadata.expected_outcome: SUCCESS - mandate-as-code with anchor hash, trace chain, 2 COAs
